endorsements.label: DCFluX in: The Man with the Soldering Gun
endorsements.description: Is this $3.99 soldering iron any good? What about RF induction soldering irons? These questions and more will be answered when you attend this talk. Less than 1 hour will teach you soldering techniques to last a life time. For everyone from the complete novice to the advanced at home prototype engineer.

endorsements.name: Matt Krick
endorsements.label: DCFluX in: Moon-bouncer
endorsements.description: This presentation will look at ways you can get critical data across the country during a wired infrastructure break down, Including taking over satellites, low altitude wifi via weather balloons, and bouncing signals off the moon. We will also take a look at some other stuff you can blame us for as time permits.

endorsements.name: Matt Krick
endorsements.label: DCFluX in: License to Transmit
endorsements.description: When cell phones, land lines and the internet break down in a disaster, Amateur radio is there. Considered to be one of the earliest forms of Hacking, this talk will take a look at some of the things that can be done if you are a licensed amateur radio operator.
